about_the_game:
📦 Overview

Experience the first steps of a cardboard box coming to life!
In this demo for The Box is Alive, you’ll roll, tumble, and flap your way through the tutorial and the full first level of the game — a physics-based comedy platformer where every movement is clumsy, funny, and oddly satisfying.

Start by mastering your newfound “boxiness” in the tutorial, learning to jump, glide, and tilt your way around obstacles. Then put those skills to the test in Level 1, where the box gains consciousness for the very first time and must escape the chaotic shipping facility of Boreal.

🟫 Demo Features

  • Full Tutorial Level – Learn all the core mechanics, from flap-jumping to gliding.

  • Level 1: The Awakening – Experience the box’s first moments of awareness in Boreal’s industrial facility.

  • Physics-Driven Comedy – Every fall, crash, and tumble tells its own goofy story.

  • Collectibles & Scoring System – Discover stamps and special stickers that will carry over to the full game’s customization system.

  • Original Soundtrack – Includes “EETS ALIVE,” the first official track from the game’s soundtrack.

short_description: A quirky physics platformer where you master the art of being a box. Roll, tilt, and glide through conveyor belts and shredders, collecting stickers and surviving the chaos of Boreal’s warehouse.
